content.text: I found several lifecycle checks split across actions and services. The acceptance path currently creates invited-status memberships, expired/revoked rows are counted inconsistently, and resend filters out expired invitations before it can find them. I’m moving the key checks into the service and aligning the repository queries with the pending definition.

The core lifecycle is now aligned: invitation expiry uses 14 days, seats count live members plus genuinely pending invitations, and acceptance validates the account and workspace before activating or restoring membership. I’ve also wired expired invitations into the resend UI and added membership-aware notification and session handling.
